FN-RT58NMY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 116
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 116 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Onsite Wastewater
Board until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
